data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a Seed-stage company in Climate & Energy founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum, having raised $10.6M to date. The sector includes nine known private peers (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen among them) and one public comparable (LNZA), though narrow peer filtration by stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints for a reliable median approach.

Given the limited peer set at this stage, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using total capital raised ($10.6M) as a value proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied value of $26M. This reflects typical dilution and risk adjustment expected between funding rounds in frontier climate technology.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $30M, centered on $26M. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently comparable same-stage or adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy, which limits confidence in the stage-progression multiple. Any refinement would require additional visibility into burn rate, technical progress, or customer traction relative to the named peer cohort. The range should be stress-tested as additional market data becomes available.
